title: Contingency Placement Agreements — Invoice Age Step in the Monthly Late-Charge Rate
content:
The monthly late-charge rate on a past-due fee invoice of an agreement under the Contingency Placement Agreements steps up with the invoice's age, counted in calendar days from the invoice date to the handling date: by half a percentage point (0.50 point) where the invoice is 150 or more days old, by a quarter of a percentage point (0.25 point) where it is at least 100 but less than 150 days old, and not at all where it is younger.

The invoice date is the date of the fee invoice entry in the agreement's client money history. The age is the difference in calendar days between the invoice date and the handling date, the invoice date not counted and the handling date counted. The step is added to the monthly rate in percentage points, and the percentage charge is the unpaid amount multiplied by the stepped-up rate.

## Step table

| Invoice age on the handling date | Step added to the monthly rate |
|---|---|
| 150 days or more | 0.50 percentage point |
| 100 to 149 days | 0.25 percentage point |
| 99 days or fewer | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical inputs)

Invoice dated 2026-01-05; a monthly rate before the step of 1.5 percent.

| Handling date | Invoice age | Monthly rate after the step |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-04-14 | 99 days | 1.5 percent |
| 2026-04-15 | 100 days | 1.75 percent |
| 2026-06-03 | 149 days | 1.75 percent |
| 2026-06-04 | 150 days | 2.0 percent |

On an unpaid amount of 1200.00 USD, a monthly rate of 2.0 percent gives a percentage charge of 24.00 USD.
